alabama.note: ALEA says a person with a valid license from the previous state may drive without an Alabama license for 30 days after becoming a resident. Full-time students with a valid home-state license are listed separately.

alaska.note: The DMV FAQ says you may drive in Alaska for up to 90 days on a valid out-of-state license, and that you need an Alaska license at that time. A commercial license is 30 days after you become a resident.

arizona.note: The ADOT 'New to Arizona' page opened on 21 Nov 2026 explains residency and what to bring. It does not state a number of days to get the license. Vehicle registration is described as 'as soon as you become an Arizona resident.'

california.note: Section 1 of the current California Driver's Handbook, and the driver license page, were opened on 21 Nov 2026. Neither states a number of days for a new resident to apply. An older handbook PDF is not used here.

connecticut.note: Once you establish residency, Connecticut gives you 90 days to transfer an out-of-state license. The same page also uses 90 days for vehicle registration. That is a separate clock.
connecticut.source: Connecticut DMV, transfer an out-of-state license

florida.note: A new Florida resident must get a Florida driver license within 30 days of establishing residency to drive on Florida roads. The same page uses 10 days for titling a vehicle, which is not the license clock.

georgia.note: You must apply for a Georgia driver license within 30 days of becoming a Georgia resident. A learner permit from another state still has to meet Georgia learner-permit rules.
georgia.source: Georgia DDS, transfer an out-of-state license

idaho.note: You must get an Idaho driver license or ID within 30 days of moving, whether the out-of-state credential has expired or not. Vehicle title and registration use the same 30 days.
idaho.source: Idaho Transportation Department, new to Idaho

indiana.note: If you move to Indiana with a valid driver license from another state, the BMV says you have 60 days to get an Indiana license. Someone without a valid out-of-state license follows the learner-permit path instead.

iowa.note: The 'New to Iowa' page opened on 21 Nov 2026 uses 30 days for the card to arrive in the mail and for a vehicle purchase. It does not state a number of days after you move to switch the license.

louisiana.note: The Office of Motor Vehicles new-license page opened on 21 Nov 2026 does not state a number of days for a new resident to switch a license.

maine.note: You must get a Maine license within 30 days of becoming a resident. A separate '30 days' on the same page is the age of a certified driving record, not the move deadline.
maine.source: Maine BMV, moved to or from another state

maryland.note: An out-of-state driver license must be updated to a Maryland license within 60 days of moving. A commercial license must be transferred within 30 days.

nebraska.note: Any new resident with a valid license from another state must get a Nebraska license within 30 days.

nevada.note: The DMV FAQ says new residents must switch an out-of-state license to a Nevada license within 30 days of moving. A second line on the same page says within 30 days of establishing residency.

new-jersey.note: You must transfer an out-of-state license within 60 days of the move, or before the current license expires, whichever comes first. Vehicle title and registration use the same 60 days outside a public-health emergency.
new-jersey.source: New Jersey MVC, moving to New Jersey

new-mexico.note: The MVD driver-license page opened on 21 Nov 2026 says a current out-of-state license waives the written test, and that a license expired a year or more does not. It does not state a number of days after you move to apply.

north-carolina.note: Within 60 days of establishing a permanent residence, if you will drive, you must get a North Carolina driver license. The same page uses a separate, usually 30 day, clock for vehicle registration.

ohio.note: You are an Ohio resident once you take a job, sign a lease, buy a home, or enroll children in school. Within 30 days you transfer the out-of-state license or ID, the title, and the registration. An unexpired non-commercial license can be exchanged at 16 or older, with a vision screening. An expired license, or a first-time driver, must complete the testing process.

pennsylvania.note: Pub 95 says a person with a valid license from another state or Canada must get a Pennsylvania license within 60 days after moving and surrender the out-of-state license. That sentence does not say the knowledge or road test is waived.

tennessee.note: The Tennessee transfer guide says a new resident who holds another state's license must get a Tennessee license within 30 days. That line was checked 16 Nov 2026. The agency site did not open on 21 Nov 2026, so this row was not re-verified today.
tennessee.source: Tennessee Department of Safety, new residents

texas.note: The Texas Driver Handbook, DL-7, revised January 2026, says new residents exchanging a valid out-of-state license have 90 days to establish residency and get a Texas license. The moving-to-Texas web page opened the same day does not state a day count. That web page does say a valid U.S. or Canadian license is surrendered and the knowledge and skills exams are not required.
texas.source: Texas Driver Handbook DL-7, revised January 2026

virginia.note: When you move to Virginia you have 60 days to get a Virginia driver license to drive there legally. A commercial license must be converted within 30 days. Titling a vehicle is a separate 30 day clock.

washington.note: The Department of Licensing testing page opened on 21 Nov 2026 uses '30 days' for how recent a driving record must be. It does not state a number of days after you move to get a Washington license.
washington.source: Washington DOL, do I need to take a test

west-virginia.note: After you establish residency, the licensing handbook says you must apply within 30 days if you want to drive. A valid unexpired out-of-state license can be transferred after a vision screening, a short alcohol awareness course, and surrender of the old license. An expired license means the first-time examinations. A later address change inside the state is 20 days, which is a different clock.

wisconsin.note: After you establish residence, a regular license is 60 days and a commercial license is 30 days.

wyoming.note: You have one year from the time you establish residency to be issued a Wyoming license, unless the license you hold is from Georgia, Massachusetts, Michigan, Tennessee, or Wisconsin, or it is a commercial license. In those cases you apply once residency is established.
